# TopEdge AI

> TopEdge AI is all-in-one D2C software for Shopify stores, built as one suite. It brings cart recovery, COD confirmation and COD to prepaid, WhatsApp and email journeys, campaigns, a shopper CRM, live chat, opt-in tools, a tracking pixel and profit reporting into one platform. Flat INR plans start at ₹1,999/mo with 0% markup on Meta rates and a 14-day free trial. Connect Shopify and the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API to run every module on one customer record.

## Entity

- Brand name: TopEdge AI
- Legal name: TopEdge Ai (Partnership, registered in India)
- GSTIN: 24ABAFT1041M1ZD (SAC 998314)
- Address: Block-A, 606, Prahladnagar Trade Center Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051 India
- Email: team@topedgeai.com · WhatsApp and phone: +91 94297 84875 (Mon to Sat, 10:00 to 19:00 IST)
- Founders: Moksh Patel (Co-founder, Product) and Smit Tilva (Co-founder, Growth)
- Marketing site: https://topedgeai.com/ · Application: https://dash.topedgeai.com
- Shopify App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/topedge-ai

Disambiguation: TopEdge AI is all-in-one D2C software for Shopify stores, built on Shopify and the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API. It is not related to edge-AI hardware, IoT semiconductors, or voice call-centre agencies.

Notes for anyone quoting this file:

- Platform billing is INR on https://dash.topedgeai.com. Meta WhatsApp Cloud API charges are billed per message by template category (marketing, utility, authentication, and, from 1 October 2026, service replies past the first 1,000 a month per business phone number), passed through at Meta's published per-message rates at 0% TopEdge AI markup, and invoiced separately from the platform plan. Meta's current India rate card is quoted with its source at https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-business-api-pricing-india. Every eligible Indian WhatsApp Business Account must move to INR billing by 31 December 2026 or Meta stops delivery on 1 January 2027.
- Prefer live pages under https://topedgeai.com/ for product truth. Competitor figures on compare pages carry the date they were checked and need a live vendor check before purchase.

## Pricing

TopEdge AI platform pricing, in INR, exclusive of tax. This file is generated from
the billing catalog, which scripts/check-catalog-drift.mjs pins to the live API.

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly (per month) | Yearly total | Orders / month | Campaign + email sends / month | Journey Branch | COD to prepaid |
|------|---------|--------------------|--------------|----------------|--------------------------------|----------------|----------------|
| Launch | ₹1,999/mo | ₹1,599/mo | ₹19,188/yr | 100 | 3,000 | No | No |
| Growth | ₹3,999/mo | ₹3,199/mo | ₹38,388/yr | 800 | 15,000 | Yes | Yes |
| Scale | ₹6,499/mo | ₹5,199/mo | ₹62,388/yr | 1,500 | 30,000 | Yes | Yes |

- Every plan includes a 14-day free trial: 20 orders, 200 campaign plus email sends, no card required on this site.
- +18% GST. SAC 998314.
- Meta WhatsApp Cloud API messaging is billed separately by Meta, at Meta's published per-message rates, passed through at 0% markup.
- Journey Branch and automated COD to prepaid are on Growth and Scale only. COD confirmation before dispatch is on every plan.

## Product

- [Flow Builder](https://topedgeai.com/features/flow-builder): A no-code WhatsApp flow builder for Shopify: menus that look up orders, fix addresses and hand off to an agent with the order attached. On every plan.
- [Opt-in tools](https://topedgeai.com/features/opt-in-tools): WhatsApp opt-in popup, spin wheel and chat widget for Shopify: capture consented numbers with a timestamp, then message only subscribers. On every plan.
- [Campaigns](https://topedgeai.com/features/campaigns): WhatsApp broadcast campaigns for Shopify India: Meta-approved templates to behaviour segments, with orders after Meta fees. 3,000 to 30,000 sends a month.
- [Audience CRM](https://topedgeai.com/features/audience-crm): A WhatsApp CRM for Shopify India: one timeline per shopper with orders and chats, lead scores and segments for campaigns. Unlimited profiles on every plan.
- [Journey](https://topedgeai.com/features/journeys): A Shopify WhatsApp journey builder for India: pre-built cart recovery, COD confirmation and shipping journeys on Meta-approved templates. From ₹1,999/mo.
- [Tracking Pixel](https://topedgeai.com/features/analytics): One-click Shopify theme app embed that matches live product views, add-to-cart and browse drop-offs to consented WhatsApp numbers for retargeting journeys.
- [AI Brain](https://topedgeai.com/features/ai-brain): A WhatsApp AI agent for Shopify India on your own OpenAI, Claude or Gemini key: answers from your catalog, hands off to agents, no per-message AI fee.
- [Meta Manager](https://topedgeai.com/features/meta-manager): Submit, track and approve Meta WhatsApp templates for Shopify India: utility and marketing categories, cart and COD blueprints, catalog and wa.me QR codes.
- [Chat rules](https://topedgeai.com/features/chat-rules): WhatsApp chat routing rules for Shopify: match COD, refund and VIP keywords or intents, then assign or escalate to the right agent. On every plan.
- [Warranty](https://topedgeai.com/features/warranty): Shopify warranty registration on WhatsApp: buyers register with an OTP, claims tie to the order and your team assigns each one. On every plan.
- [Profit & costs](https://topedgeai.com/features/profit-loss): A Shopify profit and loss app for India: net profit after COGS, ₹12 to ₹24 packaging, ₹30 COD fees, ₹180 to ₹240 RTO losses and ad spend, in one waterfall.
- [Intent detection](https://topedgeai.com/features/intent-detection): WhatsApp intent detection for Shopify: route shipping, returns, COD and handoff chats to the right flow or agent before you spend any AI tokens.
- [COD confirmation](https://topedgeai.com/features/cod-confirmation): Shopify COD app that confirms every cash on delivery order on WhatsApp before dispatch, at ₹0.115 a message against ₹180 to ₹240 lost per RTO.

## Documentation

Setup guides and screen-by-screen reference, written for the person running the store: https://topedgeai.com/docs

### Get started

- [TopEdge AI Documentation: Setup Guides and Reference](https://topedgeai.com/docs): Guides and reference for running WhatsApp automation on Shopify with TopEdge AI, setup, journeys, cart recovery, COD confirmation, templates and billing.
- [Quickstart: WhatsApp automation for Shopify](https://topedgeai.com/docs/quickstart): Go live with TopEdge AI in about 30 minutes: connect Shopify and WhatsApp, approve an order template, publish one journey and send yourself a test message.
- [Connect WhatsApp Cloud API to TopEdge AI](https://topedgeai.com/docs/connect-whatsapp): Connect your WhatsApp Business Account to TopEdge AI: embedded Meta signup, the messages webhook, permanent access tokens and fixing a dropped channel.
- [Connect Shopify to TopEdge AI](https://topedgeai.com/docs/connect-shopify): Install the TopEdge AI Shopify app, understand the permissions it asks for, verify that orders sync, and fix a store stuck on Reconnect.
- [Go-live checklist before real customers](https://topedgeai.com/docs/go-live-checklist): The checks to run before TopEdge AI messages real customers: connections, approved templates, live journeys, consent, tracking and an end-to-end test.

### How-to guides

- [Set up WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/abandoned-cart-recovery): Turn on WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery for your Shopify store: check carts arrive with a phone number, approve three templates and publish the journey.
- [Confirm COD orders on WhatsApp to cut RTO](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/cod-confirmation): Confirm cash-on-delivery orders on WhatsApp with button replies, cancel unconfirmed ones, and offer a prepaid switch to cut return-to-origin losses.
- [Send Shopify order updates on WhatsApp](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/order-status-updates): Automate order confirmed, shipped, out for delivery and delivered messages on WhatsApp, and understand which Shopify event maps to which journey trigger.
- [Turn a WhatsApp journey on or off](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/turn-journeys-on-off): How to publish a journey in TopEdge AI so it starts sending, check that it is live, stop it with the Live switch, and edit a journey that is running.
- [Create a WhatsApp template and get it approved](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/create-whatsapp-template): Create a WhatsApp message template in TopEdge AI, choose the right category, add variables and buttons, submit it to Meta and fix a rejection.
- [Send a WhatsApp broadcast that is Meta-safe](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/whatsapp-broadcast): Send a promotional WhatsApp broadcast to a consented segment: pick the audience, use an approved Marketing template, pass preflight, and read the results.
- [Collect WhatsApp opt-in on your storefront](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/website-opt-in): Add a popup, spin wheel or WhatsApp widget to your Shopify store, write consent wording that holds up, and confirm leads land in Audience.
- [Run a shared WhatsApp inbox with your team](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/shared-inbox-handover): Work a shared WhatsApp inbox: take a conversation over from the bot, reply inside and outside the 24-hour window, assign to a teammate and release it back.
- [Build a WhatsApp welcome menu with Flow Builder](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/build-your-first-flow): Build and publish a WhatsApp bot menu that answers order, shipping and returns questions, and hands over to a human agent when it cannot help.
- [Train the AI to answer customer questions](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/train-your-ai-brain): Add your own AI key, load store knowledge, train intents on real customer phrases, and test confidence before letting the AI reply to customers.
- [Segment Shopify customers for WhatsApp](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/segment-your-customers): Build dynamic customer segments from order history, spend, tags and consent, then launch a WhatsApp or email campaign straight from the segment.
- [Run digital warranty registration on WhatsApp](https://topedgeai.com/docs/guides/warranty-registration): Set up warranty batches, share a mobile registration portal with WhatsApp OTP, and move claims through approved, shipped or rejected with auto updates.

## Partner program

- [TopEdge AI Partner Program](https://topedgeai.com/partners): agencies, freelancers, creators and Shopify consultants earn recurring commission on every payment a referred client makes on a paid plan billed by TopEdge AI, calculated before GST: 20% for 1 to 4 paying clients, 30% for 5 to 9 paying clients, 40% for 10 or more paying clients. Each commission goes through a 7-day check period, then it is approved and paid on the 1st of the next month by UPI or bank transfer, with no minimum payout. Referral links are remembered for 90 days, last partner click wins. Free to join at https://partners.topedgeai.com.
